skill.displayName: Qwen Image Edit - A Revolutionary Tool for Seamless Image Editing – API-powered
skill.summary: AI image editing — edit or generate images with natural language instructions using Qwen

latestVersion.changelog:
qwen-image-edit-openapi-skill v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches AI image editing and generation with natural language via the Qwen model.
- Requires user API key for HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai; supports environment variable configuration.
- Provides endpoints to start image edit runs, poll run status, and upload images.
- Supports referencing up to 5 images and generating up to 16 result images per request.
- Includes strict API key security practices and environment variable checking.
